name: Arla Ailani
bio: Arla Ailani Muchtar (Born April 24, 2002), known as Arla Ailani is an Indonesian actress of Arab descent. Arla is the only child of the actor couple Bucek Depp and Unique Priscilla, and the niece of Fathir Muchtar and Fera Feriska. They all also work as actors.
